messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-03-17, the Atlas team decided that the image resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- As of 2026-03-17, storage for the image resizer's original uploads has doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time. [decision; valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]
- As of the 2025-11-26 handover, the image resizer's dashboards and alerts are being repointed. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
- The Atlas team owns the image resizer as of 2025-11-26, when ownership transferred from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20. [decision; valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- The Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06-2]
- The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [decision; valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-11]
- As of 2025-08-07, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team decided that the bus will retain messages for seven days, because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- The catalog service still relies on the resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- The Dune team observed on 2025-08-19 that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19-2]
- Farah is release captain for Q3 2025 for the Dune team. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-3]
- On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the handover doc for the billing API for Lena. [valid 2025-06-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
- On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the handover doc for Diego for the authentication gateway handover to Cinder. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]

Question: Why does image-resizer keep original uploads for only 90 days?

message.content: Because storage for originals doubled in six months.
